keyA.text:
Carton

Kraft (ground): the carton your lot arrives in.
Stencil ink: printed facts.
Seal red: only where something is sealed or verified.
Label white: where data lives.

Type: Archivo, condensed and black for markings, regular for reading.

Signature: seal tape runs across the master sample as you reach the inspection step.

All product, supplier and price data is the demo set, marked Example. Photos are placeholders.

titleB.text: B. Field film: what our filmer saw

keyB.text:
Field film

Floor teal (ground): the factory floor through our lens.
Board white: the dated board held in every clip.
Marker amber: dates and codes, the proof.
Steel: secondary text.

Type: Gloock (display serif) with Instrument Sans.

Signature: a scrubber steps through gate, line, QC bench and packing, with the board pinned.

Footage areas are placeholders until real, dated film exists.

titleC.text: C. Racking: the shelf in Australia

keyC.text:
Racking

Rack blue (dominant): our hubs and shelves.
Beam orange: the one action, take it off the shelf.
Concrete: ground.
Ink: text.

Type: Bricolage Grotesque, one family, wide weight range.

Signature: the unit lifts off the shelf into its product page (view transition), and the tag travels with it.

The catalogue in the app is the same shelf.
